videos.title: From coding to Knowledge work agents — Karan Vaidya, Composio
videos.summary: AI coding agents didn't succeed simply because models got smarter—they succeeded because software engineering already had git histories, CI/CD test suites, and branch protections to keep them on track. Watch this talk to discover the six critical infrastructure primitives needed to finally unleash reliable, autonomous AI agents across everyday enterprise knowledge work without catastrophic mistakes.

timestamps.topic: Why coding agents took off while knowledge-work agents fell behind
Solving the memory and context crisis across fragmented enterprise apps
Governance, policy enforcement, and reversibility for safe AI automation

videos.title: Your company brain will leak secrets: how we stopped it for big banks — Tanmai Gopal, PromptQL
videos.summary: Deploying internal AI agents across your organization risks leaking sensitive corporate data if your 'company brain' isn't architected properly. Discover why traditional memory silos and auto-saving agents fail, and learn the four essential architectural rules to safely scale collaborative AI agents using scoped wikis and virtualized credentials. If you are building enterprise AI workflows, this talk provides the blueprint to keep proprietary knowledge secure without breaking usability.

timestamps.topic: Why healthy company brains require continuous, growing contribution rates
Scoped wikis vs. auto-memory: How to safely contribute company context
Credential virtualization and the 4 rules for secure company AI

videos.title: Agents' next frontier: agent-to-agent and network effects — Jean-Denis Greze, Town
videos.summary: The true bottleneck holding AI agents back isn't intelligence—it's private data trapped in disconnected silos. Former Plaid CTO Jean-Denis Greze breaks down how to transform multi-agent systems into privacy-preserving search networks that safely share knowledge and trigger explosive network effects. Watch this talk to learn the 5 practical architectural strategies top engineers are using to build next-generation autonomous agents.

timestamps.topic: Why Running an Agent is Fundamentally a Search Problem
Privacy-Preserving Cross-Silo Tools: Exposing Signal Without Content
Black-Box Compute: Autonomous Reasoning with Approval-on-Disclosure

videos.title: Why care about functional programming
videos.summary: Tired of tracking down elusive bugs caused by changing variables and messy side effects? Scala creator Martin Odersky breaks down why functional programming makes your code drastically more predictable—to the point where you might never even need a debugger again. Watch this quick clip to discover how coding with pure values can instantly elevate your software development skills.

timestamps.topic: How programming with values eliminates side-effect bugs
Why functional code eliminates the need for debuggers

videos.title: Will there be less SWEs in 10 years?
videos.summary: Will AI replace software engineers or make the elite few unstoppable? Martin Odersky, the creator of Scala, reveals why the future of coding won't belong to average developers, but to highly skilled 'control engineers' who master math and logic to keep AI in check. Watch this short clip to understand how the engineering bar is shifting and what skills you must master to stay ahead.

timestamps.topic: Why future software engineering will demand deeper math and logic to steer AI

videos.summary: Ever wondered why compiled languages achieve blazing speeds while dynamic languages struggle with raw performance? Watch this deep dive to uncover how compilers truly operate under the hood and why mental discipline in coding can unlock massive performance gains.

Watch this concise breakdown to slash your API costs while significantly boosting your multimodal video analysis performance.

timestamps.topic: Google DeepMind's commitment to staying at the frontier of AI

videos.title: Jangan pinjamkan nama untuk joint loan?
videos.summary: Never let family members pressure you into a joint loan or 'borrowing' your name, because doing so directly ruins your Debt Service Ratio (DSR) and credit profile. Even if they promise to pay, banks will count that massive debt against your name, completely blocking you from buying your own car or home later. Watch this essential advice to learn how to stand your ground against emotional blackmail and protect your financial future.

timestamps.topic: How family members exploit guilt to get joint loans
